title: Power Plant — Fan Cowl Doors — Installation of the Reinforced Hinge Bracket and Captive Seal Strip
abstract: Installation of a bushed and reinforced fan cowl door hinge bracket together with a riveted captive seal strip, on nacelles whose cowls are opened several hundred times a year for line maintenance.

sections.planning_reason: Fan cowl doors on aircraft in short sector operation are opened three to five hundred times a year, an order of magnitude more often than the design case assumed. A survey of two hundred and twelve cowls found hinge land elongation on sixty-one of them, and in nineteen cases the fore and aft seal had partially departed and was found lodged in the cowl cavity. Seal loss changes the fan compartment ventilation path and has twice preceded a nacelle overheat indication. The elongation develops slowly and no scheduled task catches it.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin replaces the hinge bracket with a reinforced mount link carrying a bushed hinge land, and replaces the bonded fore and aft seal with a riveted captive strip. A corner bracket is added at each end of the strip to stop peel initiation. Shear head bolts secure the mount link to the existing pylon hard points. No structure is re-drilled.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Support the cowls on a trestle and remove them from the nacelle. Get access to zones 451, 455 and 462. Remove the existing hinge brackets and inspect the hinge lands, recording any elongation. Install the mount link D7110112111633 with the bolts AES484712-68 and torque them in sequence. Remove the bonded seal and clean the seal land back to bare material. Install the captive strip with the seal IB779874-66 and rivet it at the pitch given in the instructions. Install the corner bracket NY814392-02 at each end of the strip. Check the harness route that crosses the hinge line against drawing D71101167094 and confirm the clearance at the nozzle FIN 71EN. Re-hang the cowls, check the latch alignment and do a full open and close cycle. Do the cowl door repair inspection following task AMM-Z-71-10-11-300-034-A if any elongation was recorded.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable per nacelle to VDK-56B powered aircraft in the MSN Z00313 to Z08701 range. A modified cowl may be hung on an unmodified pylon, but an unmodified cowl must not be hung on a modified hinge because the bush and pin diameters differ.
sections.material_note: Kit K7110-1013-01 covers one nacelle and contains the mount link pair, the seal strip, the corner brackets, the rivet set and the bolt set. Two kits are required per aircraft. Seal cure time governs the elapsed time rather than the work content.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 36 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next cowl removal, whichever occurs first.

tooling: Rivet gun and bucking bar set

issue.reason: The bushed land limit is stated in the bulletin and the elongation measured at each land during embodiment is now returned rather than filed locally.

abstract: Installation of a bushed and reinforced fan cowl door hinge bracket with a riveted captive seal strip, now carrying the bushed land limit and the requirement to return the elongation measured at every land during embodiment.
